name: scheduler
title: Scheduler
description: A day, week or month of events over time slots: drag to move or resize, pick free slots to book.

SchedulerRoot.description: The card and its state: put `SchedulerToolbar` and `SchedulerGrid` inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card.

props.name: views
props.description: The views the switch offers, in order.

props.name: date
props.description: Any moment in the day, week or month shown. Defaults to today.

props.name: onDateChange
props.description: Called with midnight (in `timeZone`) of the new day as the period changes.

props.name: events
props.description: The events. Leave it out and pass `defaultEvents` to let the Scheduler keep them.

props.name: onEventChange
props.description: After a drag, a resize or a keyboard move: the event with its new times, then as it was.

props.name: onEventOpen
props.description: A click, Enter or Space on an event.

props.name: onSlotSelect
props.description: Slots picked with the pointer or Enter: their start and end, or a whole day.

props.name: availability
props.description: Free or busy times, drawn under the events.

props.name: slotMinutes
props.description: Minutes per slot: the rows, the drag steps and the keyboard steps.

props.name: workingHours
props.description: From and to, in hours (`[9, 18]`); outside them the grid is bg/canvas.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: An IANA time zone ("Europe/Warsaw"). Defaults to the browser's.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 (Sunday) to 6. Defaults to `dateLocale`'s.

props.name: now
props.description: Now, for the now line and today. Defaults to the clock, updated every minute.

props.name: eventPopover
props.description: The body of a popover that opens on an event, under its title and time (and attendees).

props.name: slotPopover
props.description: The body of a popover that opens on picked slots, under "New event" and the time.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target for the popovers and hover cards.

SchedulerToolbar.description: Today, ‹ ›, the period (a button that opens a DatePickerPanel) and the view switch. `children` go before the switch (a "New event" button, a filter). Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

SchedulerGrid.description: The current view: day and week as a time grid, month as day cells. A new view crossfades in. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `div` that holds it.

Scheduler.description: The toolbar over the current view. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's root `div`. <Scheduler events={events} onEventChange={(e) => save(e)} onSlotSelect={(slot) => create(slot)} timeZone="Europe/Warsaw" />
